title.raw: 卷二十六 志第十六 天文四 Volume 26 Treatises 16: Astronomy 4

translations.literal: Treatise 16: Astronomy 4
translations.idiomatic: Treatise 16: Astronomy 4

sentences.zh: 永初元年十二月甲辰，月犯南斗。

translations.literal: On a jiachen day in the twelfth month of the first year of Yongchu, the moon trespassed against the Southern Dipper.
translations.idiomatic: On a jiachen day in the twelfth month of Yongchu 1 (420 CE), the moon trespassed against the Southern Dipper asterism.

translations.literal: The prognostication reads: "Ministers will suffer anxiety.
translations.idiomatic: The omen was read as follows: "High ministers will face grave concern.

translations.literal: " In the seventh month of the third year, the Prince of Changsha died.
translations.idiomatic: " In the seventh month of the third year, the Prince of Changsha died.

sentences.zh: 索虜寇青、司二州，大軍出救。

translations.literal: The Northern invaders raided the two provinces of Qing and Si; a great army marched out to the rescue.
translations.idiomatic: The Tuoba forces raided Qing and Si provinces, and imperial armies were dispatched in relief.

sentences.zh: 永初二年六月甲申，太白晝見。

translations.literal: On a jiashen day in the sixth month of the second year of Yongchu, Venus was seen by day.
translations.idiomatic: On a jiashen day in the sixth month of Yongchu 2, Venus shone by day.

translations.literal: The prognostication: "It signifies war and mourning; it signifies that ministers grow powerful.
translations.idiomatic: The omen read: "This foretells war and death in arms, and ministers growing strong.

translations.literal: " In the fifth month of the third year, the imperial carriage halted at dusk.
translations.idiomatic: " In the fifth month of the third year, the emperor died.

translations.literal: Shortly afterward troops were dispatched to rescue Qing and Si.
translations.idiomatic: Soon afterward armies were sent to relieve Qing and Si.

sentences.zh: 其後徐羨之等秉權，臣強之應也。

translations.literal: Thereafter Xu Xianzhi and others seized power — the fulfillment of powerful ministers.
translations.idiomatic: Thereafter Xu Xianzhi and his faction seized power — the fulfillment of the omen of overmighty ministers.

sentences.zh: 永初二年六月乙酉，熒惑犯氐。

translations.literal: On a yiyou day in the sixth month of the second year of Yongchu, Mars trespassed against Root.
translations.idiomatic: On a yiyou day in the sixth month of Yongchu 2, Mars trespassed against the Root asterism.

translations.literal: On a yisi day, it trespassed against Room.
translations.idiomatic: On a yisi day, it trespassed against the Room asterism.

sentences.zh: 占曰：「氐為宿宮，房為明堂，人主有憂。

translations.literal: The prognostication reads: "Root is the lodging palace; Room is the Bright Hall; the ruler will suffer anxiety.
translations.idiomatic: The omen read: "Root signifies the ruler's lodging palace; Room signifies the Bright Hall — the sovereign will face grave concern.

translations.literal: Room also signifies generals and chancellors; generals and chancellors will suffer anxiety.
translations.idiomatic: Room also governs generals and chancellors — they too will face grave concern.

translations.literal: Root and Room also correspond to the divisions of Yan and Yu.
translations.idiomatic: Root and Room also correspond to the territories of Yan and Yu provinces.

translations.literal: " In the fifth month of the third year, the imperial carriage halted at dusk.
translations.idiomatic: " In the fifth month of the third year, the emperor died.

sentences.zh: 七月，長沙王薨，王領兗州也。

translations.literal: In the seventh month, the Prince of Changsha died; the prince held Yan province.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month the Prince of Changsha died; he had held the governorship of Yan province.

sentences.zh: 景平元年，廬陵王義真廢，王領豫州也。

translations.literal: In the first year of Jingping, the Prince of Luling Yizhen was deposed; the prince held Yu province.
translations.idiomatic: In Jingping 1 (423 CE), Prince Yizhen of Luling was deposed; he had held the governorship of Yu province.

sentences.zh: 永初二年十月，太白犯填星於亢。

translations.literal: In the tenth month of the second year of Yongchu, Venus trespassed against Saturn in Neck.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of Yongchu 2, Venus trespassed against Saturn in the Neck asterism.

translations.literal: Neck is the division of Yan province and also corresponds to Zheng.
translations.idiomatic: Neck corresponds to Yan province and also to the state of Zheng.

sentences.zh: 占曰：「大星有大兵，金土合為內兵。

translations.literal: The prognostication reads: "When great stars clash, great armies arise; when metal and earth unite, internal warfare follows.
translations.idiomatic: The omen read: "When major stars clash, great armies arise; when the metal and earth stars unite, civil war follows.

sentences.zh: 」三年，索頭攻略青、冀、兗三州，禁兵大出，兗州失守，虎牢沒。

translations.literal: " In the third year, the Northern chieftain attacked and seized Qing, Ji, and Yan provinces; the imperial guard armies marched out in force; Yan province fell; Hulao was lost.
translations.idiomatic: " In the third year the Tuoba ruler overran Qing, Ji, and Yan; the palace guard armies marched out in force; Yan province fell and Hulao was lost.

sentences.zh: 永初三年正月丁卯，月犯南斗，占同元年。

translations.literal: On a dingmao day in the first month of the third year of Yongchu, the moon trespassed against the Southern Dipper; the prognostication was the same as in the first year.
translations.idiomatic: On a dingmao day in the first month of Yongchu 3, the moon again trespassed against the Southern Dipper, with the same omen as in Yongchu 1.

translations.literal: One reading states: "The chief consort will bear the calamity.
translations.idiomatic: An alternate reading held: "The chief consort will bear the brunt of the omen.

sentences.zh: 」二月辛卯，有星孛于虛危，向河津，掃河鼓。

translations.literal: " On a xinmao day in the second month, a broom star blazed in Emptiness and Rooftop, heading toward the River Ford and sweeping the River Drum.
translations.idiomatic: " On a xinmao day in the second month, a comet blazed in the Emptiness and Rooftop asterisms, heading toward the River Ford and sweeping through the River Drum.

translations.literal: The prognostication reads: "It signifies war and mourning.
translations.idiomatic: The omen read: "This foretells war and death in arms.

translations.literal: " In the fifth month, the imperial carriage halted at dusk.
translations.idiomatic: " In the fifth month the emperor died.

translations.literal: The following year, armies were dispatched to rescue Qing and Si.
translations.idiomatic: The following year armies were sent to relieve Qing and Si.

translations.literal: In the second month, Empress Dowager of the Xiao clan died.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month Empress Dowager Xiao died.

sentences.zh: 永初三年二月壬辰，填星犯亢。

translations.literal: On a renchen day in the second month of the third year of Yongchu, Saturn trespassed against Neck.
translations.idiomatic: On a renchen day in the second month of Yongchu 3, Saturn trespassed against the Neck asterism.

sentences.zh: 占曰：「諸侯有失國者，民多流亡。

translations.literal: The prognostication reads: "Among the feudal lords some will lose their states; the people will flee in great numbers.
translations.idiomatic: The omen read: "Some feudal lords will lose their domains and the people will flee in great numbers.

translations.literal: " One reading states: "Court ministers will raise rebellion.
translations.idiomatic: " An alternate reading held: "Court ministers will foment rebellion.

translations.literal: Neck is the division of Yan province and also corresponds to Zheng.
translations.idiomatic: Neck corresponds to Yan province and also to the state of Zheng.

sentences.zh: 」其年，索頭攻圍司、兗，兗州刺史徐琰委守奔敗，司州刺史毛德祖距守陷沒，緣河吏民，多被侵略。

translations.literal: " That year, the Northern chieftain besieged Si and Yan; the Inspector of Yan Xu Yan abandoned his defense and fled in defeat; the Inspector of Si Mao Dezu held out but the city fell; along the river officials and commoners suffered widespread invasion.
translations.idiomatic: " That year the Tuoba ruler besieged Si and Yan; Yan Inspector Xu Yan abandoned his post and fled in defeat; Si Inspector Mao Dezu held out until his city fell; officials and commoners along the river suffered widespread raids.

sentences.zh: 永初三年三月壬戌，月犯南斗，占同正月。

translations.literal: On a renxu day in the third month of the third year of Yongchu, the moon trespassed against the Southern Dipper; the prognostication was the same as in the first month.
translations.idiomatic: On a renxu day in the third month of Yongchu 3, the moon again trespassed against the Southern Dipper, with the same omen as in the first month.

translations.literal: On a bingwu day in the fifth month, it trespassed against the Yellow Thearch.
translations.idiomatic: On a bingwu day in the fifth month, it trespassed against the Yellow Thearch asterism.

translations.literal: The prognostication reads: "The chief consort will bear the calamity.
translations.idiomatic: The omen read: "The chief consort will bear the brunt of the calamity.

translations.literal: " On a xinsi day in the sixth month, the moon trespassed against Room.
translations.idiomatic: " On a xinsi day in the sixth month, the moon trespassed against the Room asterism.

sentences.zh: 占曰：「將相有憂，豫州有災。

translations.literal: The prognostication reads: "Generals and chancellors will suffer anxiety; Yu province will suffer calamity.
translations.idiomatic: The omen read: "Generals and chancellors will face grave concern, and Yu province will suffer disaster.

translations.literal: " On a guisi day, it trespassed against Jupiter in the Hairy Head.
translations.idiomatic: " On a guisi day, it trespassed against Jupiter in the Hairy Head asterism.

translations.literal: The prognostication reads: "Zhao and Wei will suffer war and famine.
translations.idiomatic: The omen read: "The regions of Zhao and Wei will suffer war and famine.

translations.literal: " That year, the barbarians attacked and seized Qing, Yan, and Si provinces.
translations.idiomatic: " That year the invaders overran Qing, Yan, and Si provinces.

sentences.zh: 廬陵王義真廢，王領豫州也。

translations.literal: The Prince of Luling Yizhen was deposed; the prince held Yu province.
translations.idiomatic: Prince Yizhen of Luling was deposed; he had held the governorship of Yu province.

translations.literal: In the second month, Empress Dowager of the Xiao clan died.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month Empress Dowager Xiao died.

sentences.zh: 元嘉三年，司徒徐羨之等伏誅。

translations.literal: In the third year of Yuanjia, the Minister over the Masses Xu Xianzhi and others were executed.
translations.idiomatic: In Yuanjia 3 (426 CE), Minister over the Masses Xu Xianzhi and his co-conspirators were executed.

sentences.zh: 永初三年九月癸卯，熒惑經太微犯左執法。

translations.literal: On a guimao day in the ninth month of the third year of Yongchu, Mars passed through the Supreme Palace Enclosure and trespassed against the Left Law Enforcer.
translations.idiomatic: On a guimao day in the ninth month of Yongchu 3, Mars traversed the Supreme Palace Enclosure and trespassed against the Left Law Enforcer star.

sentences.zh: 己未，犯右執法，占悉同上。

translations.literal: On a jiwei day, it trespassed against the Right Law Enforcer; all prognostications were as above.
translations.idiomatic: On a jiwei day it trespassed against the Right Law Enforcer; the omens were all as stated above.

translations.literal: On a guiyou day in the tenth month, Venus trespassed against the Southern Dipper.
translations.idiomatic: On a guiyou day in the tenth month, Venus trespassed against the Southern Dipper.

sentences.zh: 占曰：「國有兵事，大臣有反者。

translations.literal: The prognostication reads: "The state will have military affairs; among the great ministers some will rebel.
translations.idiomatic: The omen read: "The realm will see warfare, and some great ministers will turn traitor.

translations.literal: " On a xinsi day, Mars trespassed against Advance the Worthy.
translations.idiomatic: " On a xinsi day, Mars trespassed against the Advance the Worthy star.

translations.literal: The prognostication reads: "The Advance the Worthy office will suffer execution.
translations.idiomatic: The omen read: "Officials of the Advance the Worthy rank will be put to death.

translations.literal: " The following year, armies marched out to rescue Qing and Si.
translations.idiomatic: " The following year armies marched out to relieve Qing and Si.

sentences.zh: 景平二年，徐羨之等廢帝徙王。

translations.literal: In the second year of Jingping, Xu Xianzhi and others deposed the emperor and demoted him to prince.
translations.idiomatic: In Jingping 2 (424 CE), Xu Xianzhi and his faction deposed the emperor and reduced him to a princely rank.

sentences.zh: 元嘉三年，羨之及傅亮、謝晦悉誅。

translations.literal: In the third year of Yuanjia, Xianzhi together with Fu Liang and Xie Hui were all executed.
translations.idiomatic: In Yuanjia 3, Xianzhi together with Fu Liang and Xie Hui were all put to death.

sentences.zh: 永初三年十一月戊午，有星孛於室壁。

translations.literal: On a wuwu day in the eleventh month of the third year of Yongchu, a broom star blazed in Encampment and Wall.
translations.idiomatic: On a wuwu day in the eleventh month of Yongchu 3, a comet blazed in the Encampment and Wall asterisms.

translations.literal: The prognostication reads: "It signifies war and mourning.
translations.idiomatic: The omen read: "This foretells war and death in arms.

translations.literal: " The following year, armies rescued Qing and Si.
translations.idiomatic: " The following year armies were sent to relieve Qing and Si.

translations.literal: In the second month, Empress Dowager of the Xiao clan died.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month Empress Dowager Xiao died.

translations.literal: Encampment is the image of the inner palace.
translations.idiomatic: The Encampment asterism symbolizes the inner palace.

sentences.zh: 永初三年十一月癸亥，月犯亢、氐。

translations.literal: On a guihai day in the eleventh month of the third year of Yongchu, the moon trespassed against Neck and Root.
translations.idiomatic: On a guihai day in the eleventh month of Yongchu 3, the moon trespassed against the Neck and Root asterisms.

translations.literal: The prognostication reads: "The state will suffer anxiety.
translations.idiomatic: The omen read: "The realm will face grave concern.

translations.literal: " On a wuxu day in the twelfth month, Mars trespassed against Room.
translations.idiomatic: " On a wuxu day in the twelfth month, Mars trespassed against the Room asterism.

translations.literal: Room is the Bright Hall; the king finds it inauspicious.
translations.idiomatic: Room signifies the Bright Hall — an ill omen for the sovereign.

translations.literal: One reading states: "Generals and chancellors will suffer anxiety.
translations.idiomatic: An alternate reading held: "Generals and chancellors will face grave concern.

sentences.zh: 」景平二年，羨之等廢帝，因害之。

translations.literal: " In the second year of Jingping, Xianzhi and others deposed the emperor and then killed him.
translations.idiomatic: " In Jingping 2, Xianzhi and his faction deposed the emperor and then had him murdered.

translations.literal: In the third year of Yuanjia, Xianzhi and others were executed.
translations.idiomatic: In Yuanjia 3, Xianzhi and his co-conspirators were executed.

sentences.zh: 少帝景平元年正月乙卯，有星孛于東壁南，白色，長二丈餘，拂天苑，二十日滅。

translations.literal: On a yimao day in the first month of the first year of Jingping under the Deposed Emperor, a broom star blazed south of the Eastern Wall, white in color, more than two zhang in length, brushing the Heavenly Park; after twenty days it vanished.
translations.idiomatic: On a yimao day in the first month of Jingping 1 under the deposed emperor, a white comet blazed south of the Eastern Wall, more than twenty feet long, sweeping through the Heavenly Park; it vanished after twenty days.

translations.literal: In the second month, Empress Dowager of the Xiao clan died.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month Empress Dowager Xiao died.

sentences.zh: 十月戊午，有星孛於氐北，尾長四丈，西北指，貫攝提，向大角，東行，日長六七尺，十餘日滅。

translations.literal: On a wuwu day in the tenth month, a broom star blazed north of Root; its tail was four zhang long, pointing northwest, piercing Triumphant Arrival, heading toward the Great Horn, traveling eastward and lengthening six or seven chi per day; after more than ten days it vanished.
translations.idiomatic: On a wuwu day in the tenth month, a comet blazed north of Root with a tail four zhang long, pointing northwest; it pierced Triumphant Arrival and headed toward the Great Horn, traveling east and lengthening six or seven feet per day; it vanished after more than ten days.

translations.literal: In the fifth month of the following year, Xianzhi and others deposed the emperor.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month of the following year, Xianzhi and his faction deposed the emperor.

sentences.zh: 文帝元嘉元年十月，熒惑犯心。

translations.literal: In the tenth month of the first year of Yuanjia under Emperor Wen, Mars trespassed against Heart.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of Yuanjia 1 (424 CE) under Emperor Wen, Mars trespassed against the Heart asterism.

sentences.zh: 元嘉三年正月甲寅夜，天東南有黑氣，廣一丈，長十餘丈。

translations.literal: On the night of a jiayin day in the first month of the third year of Yuanjia, black vapor appeared in the southeast sky, one zhang wide and more than ten zhang long.
translations.idiomatic: On the night of a jiayin day in the first month of Yuanjia 3, black vapor appeared in the southeast sky, ten feet wide and more than a hundred feet long.

sentences.zh: 元嘉六年五月，太白晝見經天。

translations.literal: In the fifth month of the sixth year of Yuanjia, Venus was seen by day and crossed the sky.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month of Yuanjia 6 (429 CE), Venus shone by day and traversed the heavens.

sentences.zh: 元嘉七年三月，太白犯歲星於奎。

translations.literal: In the third month of the seventh year of Yuanjia, Venus trespassed against Jupiter in Striding Legs.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month of Yuanjia 7, Venus trespassed against Jupiter in the Striding Legs asterism.

sentences.zh: 六月，熒惑犯東井輿鬼，入軒轅。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, Mars trespassed against the Eastern Well and the Chariot and Ghost, entering the Yellow Thearch.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, Mars trespassed against the Eastern Well and Chariot-Ghost asterisms and entered the Yellow Thearch.

translations.literal: The moon trespassed against Jupiter.
translations.idiomatic: The moon trespassed against Jupiter.

sentences.zh: 十一月癸未，西南有氣，上下赤，中央黑，廣三尺，長三十餘丈，狀如旌旗。

translations.literal: On a guiwei day in the eleventh month, vapor appeared in the southwest, red above and below with black in the center, three chi wide and more than thirty zhang long, shaped like a banner and pennant.
translations.idiomatic: On a guiwei day in the eleventh month, vapor appeared in the southwest, red at top and bottom with black in the center, three feet wide and more than three hundred feet long, shaped like a banner.

sentences.zh: 十二月丙戌，有流星頭如甕，尾長二十餘丈，大如數十斛船，赤色，有光照人面，從西行經奎北大星南過，至東壁止。

translations.literal: On a bingxu day in the twelfth month, a meteor appeared with a head like a jar and a tail more than twenty zhang long, as large as a ship of several dozen hu capacity, red in color, its light shining on people's faces; it traveled from the west, passed south of the northern great star of Striding Legs, and halted at the Eastern Wall.
translations.idiomatic: On a bingxu day in the twelfth month, a meteor appeared with a head the size of a jar and a tail more than two hundred feet long, as large as a grain ship of several dozen hu capacity, glowing red with light that fell on people's faces; it traveled from the west, passed south of the northern great star of Striding Legs, and halted at the Eastern Wall.

sentences.zh: 其年，索虜寇青、司，殺刺史，掠居民。

translations.literal: That year, the Northern invaders raided Qing and Si, killed the inspectors, and plundered the inhabitants.
translations.idiomatic: That year the Tuoba forces raided Qing and Si, killed the provincial inspectors, and plundered the populace.

sentences.zh: 遣征南大將軍檀道濟討伐，經歲乃歸。

translations.literal: The General Who Conquers the South Tan Daoji was dispatched to campaign against them; only after a full year did he return.
translations.idiomatic: General Who Conquers the South Tan Daoji was dispatched on campaign; he did not return until a full year had passed.

sentences.zh: 元嘉八年四月辛未，太白晝見，在胃。

translations.literal: On a xinwei day in the fourth month of the eighth year of Yuanjia, Venus was seen by day in the Stomach.
translations.idiomatic: On a xinwei day in the fourth month of Yuanjia 8 (431 CE), Venus shone by day in the Stomach asterism.

translations.literal: In the fifth month, it trespassed against the Heavenly Gate and the Eastern Well.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month it trespassed against the Heavenly Gate and Eastern Well.

translations.literal: On a gengwu day in the sixth month, Mars entered the Eastern Well.
translations.idiomatic: On a gengwu day in the sixth month, Mars entered the Eastern Well asterism.

sentences.zh: 七月壬戌夜，白虹見東方。

translations.literal: On the night of a renxu day in the seventh month, a white rainbow appeared in the east.
translations.idiomatic: On the night of a renxu day in the seventh month, a white rainbow appeared in the east.

translations.literal: On a dingchou day, Venus trespassed against the Supreme General.
translations.idiomatic: On a dingchou day, Venus trespassed against the Supreme General star.

sentences.zh: 八月癸未，太白入太微右掖門內，犯左執法。

translations.literal: On a guiwei day in the eighth month, Venus entered within the Right Side Gate of the Supreme Palace Enclosure and trespassed against the Left Law Enforcer.
translations.idiomatic: On a guiwei day in the eighth month, Venus entered within the Right Side Gate of the Supreme Palace Enclosure and trespassed against the Left Law Enforcer.

translations.literal: On a yiwei day, Mars trespassed against the Heap of Corpses.
translations.idiomatic: On a yiwei day, Mars trespassed against the Heap of Corpses star.

sentences.zh: 九月丙寅，流星大如鬥，赤色，發太微西蕃，北行，未至北斗沒，餘光長三丈許。

translations.literal: On a bingyin day in the ninth month, a meteor as large as a dipper, red in color, issued from the western rampart of the Supreme Palace Enclosure and traveled north; before reaching the Northern Dipper it vanished, its afterglow extending some three zhang.
translations.idiomatic: On a bingyin day in the ninth month, a meteor as large as the Big Dipper, glowing red, issued from the western rampart of the Supreme Palace Enclosure and traveled north; it vanished before reaching the Northern Dipper, its afterglow extending some thirty feet.

sentences.zh: 十月丙辰，金土相犯，在須女，月奄天關東井。

translations.literal: On a bingchen day in the tenth month, metal and earth stars clashed in the Maiden; the moon eclipsed the Heavenly Gate and Eastern Well.
translations.idiomatic: On a bingchen day in the tenth month, Venus and Saturn clashed in the Maiden asterism, and the moon eclipsed the Heavenly Gate and Eastern Well.

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, the moon trespassed against the Room Sash and Hook.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month the moon trespassed against the Room Sash and Hook stars.

sentences.zh: 十年，仇池氐寇漢中，梁州失戍。

translations.literal: In the tenth year, the Di of Chouchi raided Hanzhong; Liang province lost its garrisons.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth year the Di of Chouchi raided Hanzhong and Liang province lost its frontier garrisons.

sentences.zh: 元嘉九年正月庚午，熒惑入輿鬼。

translations.literal: On a gengwu day in the first month of the ninth year of Yuanjia, Mars entered the Chariot and Ghost.
translations.idiomatic: On a gengwu day in the first month of Yuanjia 9 (432 CE), Mars entered the Chariot-Ghost asterism.

translations.literal: In the third month, the moon trespassed against the Yellow Thearch.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month the moon trespassed against the Yellow Thearch.

sentences.zh: 四月，犯左角，歲星入羽林。

translations.literal: In the fourth month, it trespassed against the Left Horn; Jupiter entered the Feathered Forest.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month it trespassed against the Left Horn, and Jupiter entered the Feathered Forest.

translations.literal: The moon trespassed against the Room Sash and Hook.
translations.idiomatic: The moon trespassed against the Room Sash and Hook.

translations.literal: On a jichou day, Venus entered the Heap of Corpses.
translations.idiomatic: On a jichou day, Venus entered the Heap of Corpses.

sentences.zh: 五月，犯軒轅，月掩南斗第六星。

translations.literal: In the fifth month, it trespassed against the Yellow Thearch; the moon eclipsed the sixth star of the Southern Dipper.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month it trespassed against the Yellow Thearch, and the moon eclipsed the sixth star of the Southern Dipper.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，熒惑入太微右掖門，犯右執法。

translations.literal: On a xinyou day, Mars entered the Right Side Gate of the Supreme Palace Enclosure and trespassed against the Right Law Enforcer.
translations.idiomatic: On a xinyou day, Mars entered the Right Side Gate of the Supreme Palace Enclosure and trespassed against the Right Law Enforcer.

translations.literal: On a bingwu day in the seventh month, the moon eclipsed the Left Horn.
translations.idiomatic: On a bingwu day in the seventh month, the moon eclipsed the Left Horn.

sentences.zh: 八月癸未，太白犯心前星。

translations.literal: On a guiwei day in the eighth month, Venus trespassed against the front star of Heart.
translations.idiomatic: On a guiwei day in the eighth month, Venus trespassed against the front star of the Heart asterism.

translations.idiomatic: Cai Xingzong, Vice Director of the Masters of Writing, citing Mars' trespass against the Right Law Enforcer, submitted his resignation; it was not accepted.

sentences.zh: 九月，諸方反者皆平，多有歸降者。

translations.literal: In the ninth month, rebels in all regions were pacified, and many surrendered.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month rebels in all regions were pacified, and many surrendered.

sentences.zh: 後失淮北四州地，彭城、兗州並為虜所沒，民流之驗也。

translations.literal: Later the four provinces north of the Huai were lost; Pengcheng and Yan province were both overrun by the Tuoba, the verification of the people going into exile.
translations.idiomatic: Later the four provinces north of the Huai were lost; Pengcheng and Yan province were both overrun by the Tuoba — the fulfillment of the omen of mass displacement.

translations.literal: Pengcheng is the territorial division of Song.
translations.idiomatic: Pengcheng is the territorial division of Song.

translations.literal: That spring, grain was dear and the people suffered famine.
translations.idiomatic: That spring grain was costly and the people suffered famine.

sentences.zh: 明年，牛多疾死，詔太官停宰牛。

translations.literal: The following year, many cattle died of disease, and an edict ordered the Palace Provisioner to cease slaughtering cattle.
translations.idiomatic: The following year many cattle died of disease, and an edict ordered the Palace Provisioner to cease slaughtering cattle.

sentences.zh: 泰始三年六月甲辰，月犯東井。

translations.literal: On a jiachen day in the sixth month of Taishi 3, the moon trespassed against the Eastern Well.
translations.idiomatic: On a jiachen day in the sixth month of Taishi 3 the moon trespassed against the Eastern Well.

translations.literal: The prognostication reads: "An army general will die.
translations.idiomatic: The omen read: "An army general will die.

translations.literal: " Mars trespassed against Chariot-Ghost.
translations.idiomatic: " Mars trespassed against the Chariot-Ghost asterism.

translations.literal: The prognostication reads: "Gold and money will be dispersed.
translations.idiomatic: The omen read: "Gold and money will be dispersed.

translations.literal: It also reads: "Within sixty days there will certainly be a great amnesty.
translations.idiomatic: The omen also read: "Within sixty days there will certainly be a great amnesty.

sentences.zh: 」八月癸卯，天子以皇后六宮衣服金釵雜物賜北征將士。

translations.literal: " On a guimao day in the eighth month, the Son of Heaven bestowed the empress's six-palace garments, gold hairpins, and miscellaneous goods upon the northern expedition troops.
translations.idiomatic: " On a guimao day in the eighth month the Son of Heaven bestowed the empress's six-palace garments, gold hairpins, and miscellaneous goods upon the northern expedition troops.

sentences.zh: 明年二月，護軍王玄謨薨。

translations.literal: In the second month of the following year, Wang Xuanmo, Protector of the Army, died.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month of the following year Wang Xuanmo, Protector of the Army, died.

sentences.zh: 泰始四年六月壬寅，太白犯輿鬼。

translations.literal: On a renyin day in the sixth month of Taishi 4, Venus trespassed against Chariot-Ghost.
translations.idiomatic: On a renyin day in the sixth month of Taishi 4 Venus trespassed against the Chariot-Ghost asterism.

translations.literal: The prognostication reads: "The people will suffer great pestilence; the dead will go unburied.
translations.idiomatic: The omen read: "The people will suffer great pestilence; the dead will go unburied.

translations.literal: " That year, pestilence spread across the realm.
translations.idiomatic: " That year pestilence spread across the realm.

sentences.zh: 泰始五年二月丙戌，月犯左角。

translations.literal: On a bingxu day in the second month of Taishi 5, the moon trespassed against the Left Horn.
translations.idiomatic: On a bingxu day in the second month of Taishi 5 the moon trespassed against the Left Horn.

translations.literal: The prognostication reads: "Within three years the Son of Heaven will find it inauspicious.
translations.idiomatic: The omen read: "Within three years the Son of Heaven will find it inauspicious.

translations.literal: " On a gengshen day in the third month, the moon trespassed against the Establishment Stars.
translations.idiomatic: " On a gengshen day in the third month the moon trespassed against the Establishment Stars.

translations.literal: The prognostication reads: "The chancellor will be changed.
translations.idiomatic: The omen read: "The chancellor will be changed.

translations.literal: " On a renwu day in the tenth month, the moon trespassed against the Net.
translations.idiomatic: " On a renwu day in the tenth month the moon trespassed against the Net asterism.

sentences.zh: 占曰：「天子用法，誅罰急，貴人有死者。

translations.literal: The prognostication reads: "The Son of Heaven will employ the law; punishments will be severe; among the nobility some will die.
translations.idiomatic: The omen read: "The Son of Heaven will employ the law; punishments will be severe; among the nobility some will die.

translations.literal: " That month on a bingshen day, Venus trespassed against the Neck.
translations.idiomatic: " That month on a bingshen day Venus trespassed against the Neck asterism.

sentences.zh: 占曰：「收斂國兵以備北方。

translations.literal: The prognostication reads: "The armies of the realm will be gathered in to guard against the north.
translations.idiomatic: The omen read: "The armies of the realm will be gathered in to guard against the north.

sentences.zh: 」其年冬，建安王休仁解揚州，桂陽王休範為揚州。

translations.literal: " That winter, Prince Xiuren of Jian'an relinquished Yang province, and Prince Xiufan of Guiyang became governor of Yang province.
translations.idiomatic: " That winter Prince Xiuren of Jian'an relinquished Yang province, and Prince Xiufan of Guiyang became governor of Yang province.

sentences.zh: 揚州牧前後常宰相居之，易相之驗也。

translations.literal: The governorship of Yang province was customarily held by chancellors before and after; this was the verification of the change of chancellor.
translations.idiomatic: The governorship of Yang province was customarily held by chancellors before and after — the fulfillment of the omen of a change of chancellor.

sentences.zh: 七年，晉平王休祐、建安王休仁並見殺。

translations.literal: In the seventh year, Princes Xiuyou of Jinping and Xiuren of Jian'an were both put to death.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh year Princes Xiuyou of Jinping and Xiuren of Jian'an were both put to death.

sentences.zh: 時失淮北，立戍以備防北虜。

translations.literal: At the time the realm had lost the territory north of the Huai, and garrisons were established to guard against the Northern Tuoba.
translations.idiomatic: At the time the realm had lost the territory north of the Huai, and garrisons were established to guard against the Northern Tuoba.

translations.literal: Three years later, the emperor died.
translations.idiomatic: Three years later, the emperor died.

sentences.zh: 泰始六年正月辛巳，月犯左角，同前占。

translations.literal: On a xinsi day in the first month of Taishi 6, the moon trespassed against the Left Horn, the same prognostication as before.
translations.idiomatic: On a xinsi day in the first month of Taishi 6 the moon trespassed against the Left Horn, with the same omen as before.

translations.literal: On a renchen day in the eighth month, Mars trespassed against the Southern Dipper.
translations.idiomatic: On a renchen day in the eighth month Mars trespassed against the Southern Dipper.

translations.literal: The Southern Dipper is the territorial division of Wu.
translations.idiomatic: The Southern Dipper is the territorial division of Wu.

sentences.zh: 十一月乙亥，月犯東北轅。

translations.literal: On a yihai day in the eleventh month, the moon trespassed against the Northeast Shaft.
translations.idiomatic: On a yihai day in the eleventh month the moon trespassed against the Northeast Shaft.

translations.literal: The prognostication reads: "The great man will bear the brunt of the omen.
translations.idiomatic: The omen read: "The great man will bear the brunt of the calamity.

translations.literal: It also reads: "Among great ministers, some will be executed.
translations.idiomatic: The omen also read: "Among great ministers, some will be put to death.

translations.literal: " In the second year, Wang Jingwen, governor of Yang province, was put to death.
translations.idiomatic: " In the second year Wang Jingwen, governor of Yang province, was put to death.

translations.literal: The emperor died.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor died.

sentences.zh: 後廢帝元徽三年七月丙申，太白入角，犯歲星。

translations.literal: On a bingshen day in the seventh month of Yuanhui 3 under the Deposed Emperor, Venus entered the Horn and trespassed against Jupiter.
translations.idiomatic: On a bingshen day in the seventh month of Yuanhui 3 under the Deposed Emperor, Venus entered the Horn and trespassed against Jupiter.

sentences.zh: 占曰：「角為天門，國將有兵事。

translations.literal: The prognostication reads: "Horn is the Gate of Heaven; the state will have military affairs.
translations.idiomatic: The omen read: "Horn is the Gate of Heaven; the realm will see warfare.

sentences.zh: 」占，于角太白與木星會，殺軍在外，破軍殺將。

translations.literal: " According to the prognostication, when at Horn Venus and Jupiter meet, armies abroad will be slaughtered and defeated armies will lose their generals.
translations.idiomatic: " The prognostication held that when Venus and Jupiter meet at Horn, armies abroad are destroyed and defeated forces lose their generals.

translations.literal: That month on a dingsi day, Venus entered Root.
translations.idiomatic: That month on a dingsi day Venus entered the Root asterism.

sentences.zh: 氐為天子宿宮，太白兵凶之星。

translations.literal: Root is the Son of Heaven's lodging palace; Venus is the star of armies and disaster.
translations.idiomatic: Root is the Son of Heaven's lodging palace; Venus is the star of armies and disaster.

sentences.zh: 八月己巳，太白犯房北頭第二星。

translations.literal: On a jisi day in the eighth month, Venus trespassed against the second star at the northern head of Room.
translations.idiomatic: On a jisi day in the eighth month Venus trespassed against the second star at the northern head of Room.

translations.literal: The prognostication reads: "The king will lose virtue.
translations.idiomatic: The omen read: "The king will lose virtue.

sentences.zh: 」九月癸卯，太白犯南斗第三星。

translations.literal: " On a guimao day in the ninth month, Venus trespassed against the third star of the Southern Dipper.
translations.idiomatic: " On a guimao day in the ninth month Venus trespassed against the third star of the Southern Dipper.

translations.literal: The prognostication reads: "The great man will bear the brunt of the omen; the state will change its government.
translations.idiomatic: The omen read: "The great man will bear the brunt of the calamity; the state will change its government.

translations.literal: " On a bingxu day in the tenth month, Jupiter entered Root.
translations.idiomatic: " On a bingxu day in the tenth month Jupiter entered the Root asterism.

sentences.zh: 占曰：「諸侯人君有來入宮者。

translations.literal: The prognostication reads: "Among feudal lords and rulers, some will come to enter the palace.
translations.idiomatic: The omen read: "Among feudal lords and rulers, some will come to enter the palace.

sentences.zh: 」十一月庚戌，月入太微，奄屏西南星。

translations.literal: " On a gengxu day in the eleventh month, the moon entered the Supreme Palace Enclosure and eclipsed the southwest star of the Screen.
translations.idiomatic: " On a gengxu day in the eleventh month the moon entered the Supreme Palace Enclosure and eclipsed the southwest star of the Screen.

translations.literal: The prognostication reads: "The noble will lose power.
translations.idiomatic: The omen read: "The noble will lose power.

sentences.zh: 」四年七月，建平王景素據京口反。

translations.literal: " In the seventh month of the fourth year, Prince Jingsu of Jianping rebelled and held Jingkou.
translations.idiomatic: " In the seventh month of the fourth year Prince Jingsu of Jianping rebelled and held Jingkou.

sentences.zh: 時廢主凶慝無度，五年七月殞，安成王入篡皇阼。

translations.literal: At the time the deposed emperor was vicious beyond measure; in the fifth year he died in the seventh month, and the Prince of Ancheng seized the throne.
translations.idiomatic: At the time the deposed emperor was vicious beyond measure; in the fifth year he died in the seventh month, and the Prince of Ancheng seized the throne.

translations.literal: Three years later, Qi received the abdication.
translations.idiomatic: Three years later, Qi received the abdication.

sentences.zh: 元徽四年三月乙巳，月犯房北頭第一星，進犯鍵閉星。

translations.literal: On a yisi day in the third month of Yuanhui 4, the moon trespassed against the first star at the northern head of Room and advanced to trespass against the Lock and Bolt star.
translations.idiomatic: On a yisi day in the third month of Yuanhui 4 the moon trespassed against the first star at the northern head of Room and advanced to trespass against the Lock and Bolt star.

sentences.zh: 占曰：「有謀伏甲兵在宗廟中，天子不可出宮下堂，多暴事。

translations.literal: The prognostication reads: "There is a plot with hidden armor and troops in the ancestral temple; the Son of Heaven must not leave the palace or descend the hall; many violent affairs will follow.
translations.idiomatic: The omen read: "There is a plot with hidden armor and troops in the ancestral temple; the Son of Heaven must not leave the palace or descend the hall; many violent affairs will follow.

translations.literal: " On a jiachen day in the ninth month, Saturn trespassed against the western battlement of the Supreme Palace Enclosure.
translations.idiomatic: " On a jiachen day in the ninth month Saturn trespassed against the western battlement of the Supreme Palace Enclosure.

translations.literal: The prognostication reads: "A king will be enthroned.
translations.idiomatic: The omen read: "A king will be enthroned.

translations.literal: One reading says: "A king will be relocated.
translations.idiomatic: One reading held: "A king will be relocated.

translations.literal: It also reads: "The great man will suffer anxiety.
translations.idiomatic: The omen also read: "The great man will suffer anxiety.

sentences.zh: 」時廢帝出入無度，卒以此殞，安成王立。

translations.literal: At the time the deposed emperor came and went without restraint; he ultimately died because of this, and the Prince of Ancheng was enthroned.
translations.idiomatic: At the time the deposed emperor came and went without restraint; he ultimately died because of this, and the Prince of Ancheng was enthroned.

sentences.zh: 元徽五年正月戊申，月犯南斗第五星。

translations.literal: On a wushen day in the first month of Yuanhui 5, the moon trespassed against the fifth star of the Southern Dipper.
translations.idiomatic: On a wushen day in the first month of Yuanhui 5 the moon trespassed against the fifth star of the Southern Dipper.

translations.literal: The prognostication was the same as before.
translations.idiomatic: The prognostication was the same as before.

sentences.zh: 四月丁巳，熒惑犯輿鬼西北星。

translations.literal: On a dingsi day in the fourth month, Mars trespassed against the northwest star of Chariot-Ghost.
translations.idiomatic: On a dingsi day in the fourth month Mars trespassed against the northwest star of the Chariot-Ghost asterism.

sentences.zh: 占曰：「大人憂，近期六十日，遠期六百日。

translations.literal: The prognostication reads: "The great man will suffer anxiety; in the near term sixty days, in the far term six hundred days.
translations.idiomatic: The omen read: "The great man will suffer anxiety; in the near term sixty days, in the far term six hundred days.

translations.literal: It also reads: "The ruler will find it inauspicious.
translations.idiomatic: The omen also read: "The ruler will find it inauspicious.

sentences.zh: 」其月丙子，太白犯輿鬼西北星。

translations.literal: " That month on a bingzi day, Venus trespassed against the northwest star of Chariot-Ghost.
translations.idiomatic: " That month on a bingzi day Venus trespassed against the northwest star of the Chariot-Ghost asterism.

translations.literal: The prognostication reads: "There will be a great amnesty.
translations.idiomatic: The omen read: "There will be a great amnesty.

sentences.zh: 」五月戊申，太白晝見午上，光明異常。

translations.literal: " On a wushen day in the fifth month, Venus was seen by day above the noon position, its brilliance abnormal.
translations.idiomatic: " On a wushen day in the fifth month Venus was seen by day above the noon position, its brilliance abnormal.

translations.literal: The prognostication reads: "The dynastic surname will change.
translations.idiomatic: The omen read: "The dynastic surname will change.

translations.literal: " On a renxu day in the sixth month, the moon trespassed against the Hooked Clasp star.
translations.idiomatic: " On a renxu day in the sixth month the moon trespassed against the Hooked Clasp star.

translations.literal: The prognostication reads: "There will be a great command.
translations.idiomatic: The omen read: "There will be a great command.

translations.literal: " That month on a yichou day, the moon trespassed against the fourth star of the Southern Dipper.
translations.idiomatic: " That month on a yichou day the moon trespassed against the fourth star of the Southern Dipper.

translations.literal: The prognostication was the same as before.
translations.idiomatic: The prognostication was the same as before.

translations.literal: In the seventh month, the deposed emperor perished; a great amnesty was proclaimed throughout the realm.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month the deposed emperor died, and a great amnesty was proclaimed throughout the realm.

translations.literal: Two years later, Qi received the abdication.
translations.idiomatic: Two years later the Qi dynasty received the abdication of the throne.

sentences.zh: 順帝升明元年八月庚申，月入南斗，犯第三星，與前同占。

translations.literal: On a gengshen day in the eighth month of the first year of Shengming under Emperor Shun, the moon entered the Southern Dipper and trespassed against the third star; the prognostication was the same as before.
translations.idiomatic: On a gengshen day in the eighth month of Shengming 1 under Emperor Shun, the moon entered the Southern Dipper and trespassed against the third star, with the same omen as before.

sentences.zh: 九月丁亥，太白在翼，晝見經天。

translations.literal: On a dinghai day in the ninth month, Venus was in the Wings, seen by day and crossing the sky.
translations.idiomatic: On a dinghai day in the ninth month, Venus stood in the Wings, shining by day and traversing the heavens.

translations.literal: The prognostication reads: "The ruling house will change.
translations.idiomatic: The omen read: "The ruling house will change.

sentences.zh: 」閏十二月癸卯夜，月奄南斗第四星，與前同占。

translations.literal: " On the night of a guimao day in the intercalary twelfth month, the moon eclipsed the fourth star of the Southern Dipper; the prognostication was the same as before.
translations.idiomatic: " On the night of a guimao day in the intercalary twelfth month, the moon eclipsed the fourth star of the Southern Dipper, with the same omen as before.
